hub.title: Reports & analytics
hub.subtitle: Evidence-bounded field performance, environmental context and anomaly signals. Only metrics the backend actually returns are rendered.
hub.noFieldHint: These analytics describe one field. Pick a field in the context bar (or on the map) and every section fills from its real data.

index.label: Vegetation index
index.hint: Switching the index updates every chart and card on this page.

field.title: Field performance
field.subtitle: Vegetation history, spatial variation and statistical zones for the selected field.
field.historyDesc: Valid observations of the selected index over time, with the baseline mean for reference.
field.freshFresh: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} since the last valid observation — fresh
field.freshStale: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} since the last valid observation — stale
field.trendNote: Trend ({method}): {slope} per 30 days across {points} points — a statistical fit, not a forecast.
field.variationDesc: Percentiles of the pixel values inside the field boundary (latest processed scene).
field.subfieldNo: Not enough support for sub-field claims
field.noVariation: The latest processed scene did not return spatial variation statistics.
field.distributionDesc: Histogram of pixel values with the share outside the documented index range.
field.heatmapDesc: Mean value per statistical tercile zone for every processed scene.
field.statisticalNote: Statistical terciles — not agronomic zones. They rank pixel values per scene and must not be managed as management zones.
field.zonesDesc: Pixel share, mean and value range per tercile from the latest zone summary.
field.noZones: No statistical zones were computed for this field yet.
field.coverageDesc: Scene coverage of the satellite timeline and gaps longer than the revisit window.
field.gapsNone: No revisit gaps were reported by the API.
field.insufficientIntro: The satellite profile is not asserted while these gates fail:

environment.title: Environmental context
environment.subtitle: Real observation series ingested for this field. Nothing here is simulated or estimated client-side.
environment.precipDesc: Monthly totals of the daily precipitation observation series (mm/month).
environment.tempDesc: Monthly means of the daily air temperature series (°C).
environment.moistureDesc: Monthly means of the surface volumetric soil moisture series (m³/m³).
environment.et0Desc: Monthly totals of the daily reference evapotranspiration series (mm/month).
environment.excluded: {count} observations excluded (no value or invalid quality)
environment.gapsNone: No missing months between the first and latest observation.
environment.notExposedTitle: Not exposed by the API yet
environment.notExposedIntro: The layer catalog declares these series but no pipeline ingests them — they cannot be charted here:
environment.noSeriesHint: Ingest observations for this field to populate this page. The catalog lists no available series, so nothing is drawn.
environment.noRangeData: No observations for this variable in the selected range.

anomalies.title: Anomaly signals
anomalies.subtitle: Quality-gated statistical signals. They are never diagnoses and never imply a cause.
anomalies.noneHint: The gated detector returned no signals for this field and index. This is an empty result — not a clean bill of health.
anomalies.gatesIntro: The detector did not evaluate this field while these gates fail:
anomalies.notDiagnosis: NOT a diagnosis — this is a statistical signal. Disease, pest, nutrient or irrigation claims require independent evidence.
anomalies.compareDesc: Pick a second field and/or two acquisition dates. Deltas appear only when the compatibility check passes.
anomalies.incompatIntro: No delta is shown because the compatibility check failed:
anomalies.correlationNote: Differences are described side by side. This comparison does not establish cause, attribution or correlation-as-causation.
anomalies.noDates: No processed acquisitions available for this index yet.
anomalies.scatterDesc: One point per statistical tercile zone — identical values would sit on the dashed line.
anomalies.deltaChartDesc: Mean per tercile zone on side A, side B, and their delta (only shown while comparable).

reportTypes.fieldScopeNote: Single-field scope uses the selected field: {name}

charts.noDataForPeriod: No data for this selection yet.
charts.histogramFooter: Documented range {range} · {outOfRange} of pixels outside it
charts.legendRange: Scale normalized inside the documented range {range}
